improvements.summary: Send each conversation's existing Session ID in OpenCode request headers across pi-ai protocols, preserving provider attribution and unrelated routes.
Keep persistent Bash and PowerShell truncation and timeout guidance accurate.
Add opt-in compaction request limits and profile composition without changing the official loop or presets.
Keep frontend-static serving confined to resolved targets inside its configured distribution root and prove symlink or junction escapes cannot return outside bytes.
Keep the official mirror clean and make every custom delta attributable to an extension, upstream patch, or repository policy.
Treat ignored dependency build scripts as non-installable until the profile records and receives explicit approval.
Keep published dependency versions and desktop archive extraction free of known high-severity advisories.
Keep the client store and approval/session package documentation aligned with their public contracts.
Keep package README runtime invariants before the final development note and protect the order with a corpus gate.
Migrate Session title owners from deprecated synchronous history reads to an asynchronous or projected reader contract.
Keep registered Session projections exact for unpublished prepared Sessions before Agent construction.
Keep interaction-owned current-event reads and synchronous Session invariants exact across creation, append, restore, and provider lifetimes, including direct consumer fixture coverage.
Keep current-event context readers and cached Session projection state exact across append, replay, and runtime changes.
Operate the audit-derived Triple-A quality program through a frozen quality bar, one canonical backlog, persistent state, and independent verification.
Keep workspace-change deliverable tests isolated across concurrent runs and asynchronous teardown.
Keep source-launched runtime resolution, build cleanup, catalog boot fixtures, and CI tests compatible with supported runners.
Remove unsupported package source exports and keep packed public entry points aligned with the files payload.
Keep Conversation, Browser, and document-preview implementation files in their owning client domains.
Make Gateway stream-client disposal await physical WebSocket close and isolate late callbacks.
Bound aggregate buffered HTTP and RPC intake with an instance-owned reservation and quiescent release.
Keep dynamic extension deployment explicit, consented, publisher-aware, restrictive, and disabled by default.
Keep M30 V8 coverage exclusions stable through transforms and compiler-generated accessors, and document the measured corpus and exceptions.
Verify LocalJobRegistry completion listeners receive settled jobs while their owning mount remains active.
Keep historical Schedule event projection checks and core-tools invariant readers on exact Session baselines with pre-append rejection.
Keep fork test fixtures and module resolution compatible with the current official Session baseline and source launch while merging upstream master.
Validate structured audit findings, reconcile independent reports, and measure sanitized session evidence without treating missing checks as a pass.
Give each default Web invocation an OS-assigned listening port and keep browser-window lifecycle evidence explicit.
Guide delegated audits through evidence capture, tool preflight, progressive reads, conflict resolution, and independent review.
Offer an opt-in profile patch with bounded read output for audit sessions.
